title: Chapter 276 Lu Xue Competes For The Ranking
content:
Chapter 276 Lu Xue Competes For The Ranking

"Um?"

The man asked suspiciously and then took out an exquisite token.

The word "Heaven and Earth" is engraved on the token.

Feeling the message from the token, the man suddenly burst into veins.

boom!

With a loud bang, a terrifying immortal power surged out of his body like a tide.

In just a moment, all the stone statues around them were shattered into powder.

It is hard to imagine that the men before have always used brute force.

Now, with the blessing of the man's fairy power, the surrounding stone statues have no power to resist at all.

You should know that each of these stone statues has the strength of the peak of the Immortal Saint Realm!

"After eating the courage of Xiongxin and leopard, he dared to come to provoke Tiandi Academy!"

The man spoke ferociously, then soared into the air like a wild beast, rushing towards the direction of Tiandi Academy.

There are many people who exist like men in the fairyland.

At this moment, they all put down their affairs and rushed towards the direction of Tiandi Academy.

Tiandi Academy.

After the challenge of Dao Qing, the cultivation atmosphere of the entire academy suddenly became much stronger.

Basically every student began to practice seriously.

The secret cultivation realm inside the academy also began to be overcrowded and could not enter without an appointment.

And there are many more people who are making the rankings.

After a brief adaptation, Lu Xue was also preparing to test her current strength.

Standing in front of the martial arts tower, Lu Xue adjusted her mentality slightly, and then went forward alone.

The next moment, a beam of light shone out from the Martial Tower and shone directly on Lu Xue.

Buzz —

The space trembled slightly, and Lu Xue disappeared from the spot immediately.

"Sister Xue's first martial arts list is here, I don't know how far she can."

Outside the Wu Tower.

Qin Feng and Xiao Luo looked at the Wu Tower in front of them, and felt inexplicably excited.

They had never seen Lu Xue show his strength.

But when they thought of that, the two of them dared not underestimate Lu Xue's strength.

After all, a tiger father has no dog daughter.

"Sister Xue can enter the top 30 no matter how hard she does."

Qin Feng spoke tentatively.

Although he did not see Lu Xue’s current cultivation level, according to what he felt, Lu Xue had not yet broken through to the Immortal Saint Realm.

Without the Immortal Saint Realm, it is already very good to be able to reach the top 30 of the martial arts list.

At this time, Ao Qing, who had been silent on the side, suddenly snorted coldly: "The top thirty? What's that? The little master is an unprecedented genius and a peerless genius who has no future. The little master will definitely be the first in the martial arts list!"

The first place in the martial arts list!

Qin Feng and the others looked at each other with disbelief on their faces.

Qin Feng knew very well how difficult it was to be the first in the martial arts list.

Not to mention the top five in the martial arts list, the top five in the martial arts list are definitely very terrifying.

The existence of these nouns is basically a monster that is preparing to attack the monster list.

Without the strength of the Immortal Emperor Realm, it is very difficult to defeat them.

But the two of them dared not refute Ao Qing's words, but just laughed a few times.

Ao Qing just snorted coldly, then turned around and continued to look at the Wu Tower.

Look, the little master will definitely be famous all over the world.

At the same time, changes have begun to occur on the martial arts list.

The 100th place in the martial arts list suddenly turned into Lu Xue.

"So fast! Sister Xue is so strong!"

How long has it been since Lu Xue defeated the 100th place.

However, as soon as the words were finished, the martial arts list changed again.

I saw Lu Xue's name go from the 100th place all the way up.

No.99,

No. 98,

No.97,

......

It was not until the 50th place that the growth rate of Lu Xue's noun began to gradually decrease.

In other words, Lu Xue killed all the top fifty places on the martial arts list in seconds.

Thinking of this, Qin Feng was extremely excited.

Too strong, Sister Xue is really too strong.

The change in the martial arts list instantly attracted other people in the academy.

"What, I'm fighting from the 1100th martial arts list to the 50th one breath. Where does this monster come from?!"

"Lu Xue? This name sounds so familiar."

"I remembered that this is the disciple of Teacher Xiao Yin, the person from Zhuyun Peak!"

For a moment, the name Lu Xue suddenly became loud in the academy.

Countless disciples from the inner courtyard rushed to the square to watch.

I saw that Lu Xue's ranking was still rising.

In just a few cups of tea, Lu Xue had already reached the 40th place in the martial arts list.

"It seems that I underestimated Sister Xue."

Qin Feng looked at Lu Xue, who was at the 40th place in the martial arts list, and his face looked a little embarrassed.

I just said that I could reach the top 30 of the martial arts list. Now, judging from Lu Xue’s speed of playing the rankings, it is not an exaggeration to reach the top 10.

This idea is not only Qin Feng, but the rest of the people present also thought so.

Ao Qing smiled disdainfully at this.

"I have long said that the little master is unparalleled in talent. Let's take a look. Now I know what a person with destiny is."

"A man of destiny?"

As soon as Ao Qing finished speaking, a murmur sounded beside him.

Qin Feng and others were stunned and immediately saw Xu Zijing coming from a distance.

"Oh, Brother Xu, you are indeed indispensable to joining in the fun."

When Qin Feng saw Xu Zijing, he hurriedly said hello.

Since he learned that this guy had been hiding his strength, Qin Feng did not dare to underestimate Xu Zijing at all.

Xiao Luo also nodded to Xu Zijing.

As for Ao Qing, he didn't care about Xu Zijing at all. He just glanced lightly, and then continued to look at Wuta intently.

Since following Lu Xue out of the deserted city, Ao Qing has disdained anyone.

No matter how powerful you are, your background can be better than me.

Xu Zijing gave a greeting to Qin Feng and the others, and then looked at Ao Qing next to him.

The posture of the Nine-Clawed Dragon is particularly obvious.

In fact, Ao Qing rarely turns into a human form, basically this is the case.

For convenience, Ao Qing only made the body smaller.

If everyone hadn't been staring at the martial arts list at this moment, Ao Qing would have been penetrated by everyone's eyes.

Looking at Ao Qing in front of him, Xu Zijing adjusted his emotions and then smiled and said, "Brother Long, I wonder what the destiny person you just mentioned means?"

The place where the few people stayed was deserted, so only Ao Qing, Qin Feng and others could hear Xu Zijing's words.

At this moment, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo were a little nervous.

The matter of the destiny of the man was told by the Lord of the Huang City.

So now, I'm afraid only a few of them know Lu Xue's identity in the entire fairy world.

But now, Xu Zijing heard what Ao Qing said just now.

Although Ao Qing said it unintentionally, the two of them were still a little afraid that Ao Qing would reveal something.

Lu Xue has not grown up yet. If something happens, the entire fairy world will be over.

The two of them were about to speak, but the next moment, Ao Qing scolded, "Which onion are you? Get out of here!"

A evil aura slowly overflowed from the body of Ao Qing.

Ao Qing's face was fierce and she stared at Xu Zijing in front of her.

Even Qin Feng and the others, who were a little far away, felt Ao Qing's horror.

What's more, Xu Zijing, who was right in front of Ao Qing.

"I,,"

Under Ao Qing's terrifying deterrence, even Xu Zijing, who had been hiding his strength, couldn't help but take two steps back.

The power of the nine-clawed dragon is indeed well-known.
